ABOUT
Corporate Commitment

Certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 and registered CIDB G7. The certificates, the policies and the safety record are published here in full.

Sustainability and responsibility, our commitment.

Our corporate commitments guide how we work with our people, customers, partners and the wider environment. We aim to conduct our business responsibly, with attention to safety, integrity, operational discipline and continual improvement.

E
Environmental responsibility

IAQ is dedicated to minimising its environmental footprint through sustainable design and construction practices. It continuously seeks energy-efficient solutions and prioritises eco-friendly technologies.

S
Social accountability

The well-being and safety of employees and communities come first. IAQ promotes a diverse and inclusive work environment and upholds ethical labour practices.

G
Corporate governance

Governance practices ensure transparency, accountability and ethical decision-making. IAQ adheres to the highest standards in compliance, fostering trust and credibility with clients, partners and stakeholders.

Quality, environment, health and safety.

The IAQ Group is committed to environment, safety and health as a core business function, promoting safe and healthy working conditions without risk of harm to its employees or others affected by its undertakings, and without harm to assets or the environment.

IAQ has established the highest levels of EHS standards and applies proactive EHS management through responsible planning and implementation. Every incident is preventable, and no task is so important that it is worth endangering the health and well-being of employees and partners.

IAQ Quality Policy

The commitment behind ISO 9001:2015: meet customer, statutory and regulatory requirements, enhance customer satisfaction and continually improve the quality management system.

Signed by the Chief Executive Officer, 15 November 2024
